high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Pronounced longitudinal dorsal ridge creating a distinct geometric divide between the left and right dorsal planes; no unnatural traumatic depressions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed linear marks/striations consistent with low-depth epidermal abrasions along the mid-dorsal axis.
